question: (1)/(20) { is what percentage of } (10)/(60) ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Required Percentage = (Target Value ÷ Base Value) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = [(1/20) ÷ (10/60)] × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = (1/20) × (60/10) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = (3/10) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = 30%

**∴ The correct answer is 30%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Target value = 1/20

Base value = 10/60

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Target Value ÷ Base Value) × 100

 
 Base = 10/60 = 1/6
 100%

 
 Target = 1/20
 30%

 
• 
 
• 
 
• 

 Percentage = (1/20) ÷ (1/6) × 100 = 30%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Base value = 10/60 = 1/6

⇒ Percentage = (1/20) ÷ (1/6) × 100

⇒ Percentage = (1/20) × 6 × 100

⇒ Percentage = (6/20) × 100

⇒ Percentage = 6 × 5

⇒ Percentage = 30%

**∴ The correct answer is 30%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

A is what percentage of B?

Formula: (A ÷ B) × 100. It compares the target value A with the base value B and expresses the ratio out of 100.

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

To convert any simplified fraction a/b to a percentage, multiply it directly by 100. For example, 1/5 × 100 = 20%.

Percentage Change

Percentage Change = [(Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value] × 100
